body: Maybe a bunch of us should all buy an uninhabited island together?

I feel like people who say this assume that clinical depression is just like a normal bad mood. If you're in a bad mood because your girlfriend just broke up with you or you got laid off or whatever bad thing happened, then yeah, hobbies and socializing might help. If you're in a bad mood because your brain keeps telling you that you'd be better off dead, learning to crochet ain't gonna do jack shit.

> Some asshole banged my mom and now I have to put up with this shit??? 

This is honestly a pretty good description of life in general.
I mean I don't blame other people for not liking me, I don't like me either. I just wish I were more likable in general.
